blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lowering fees can significantly increase the use of digital payments, a new survey found, suggesting that payment pricing affects more than the cost of a transaction. A survey of 15,000 mobile banking users at Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. (RCBC) showed that users doubled their transactions after the bank reduced fees to zero. In another RCBC mobile banking platform, users increased their transactions by about 30 percent.
